minecraft:emitter_initialization.creation_expression: variable.dir ?? { variable.dir.x = 0.0; variable.dir.y = -1.0; variable.dir.z = 0.0; }; variable.vel ?? { variable.vel.x = 0.0; variable.vel.y = 0.0; variable.vel.z = 0.0; }; variable.pw = math.clamp(variable.power ?? 1.0, 0.0, 1.0); variable.spd = 0.6 + 0.4 * variable.pw; variable.boost = math.clamp((variable.pw - 0.78) * 4.5, 0.0, 1.0);

minecraft:particle_initialization.per_render_expression: variable.lt = math.clamp(variable.particle_age / variable.particle_lifetime, 0.0, 1.0); variable.om = variable.particle_random_4 < 0.25 ? variable.boost : 0.0;

components.minecraft:particle_initial_speed: math.sqrt((variable.dir.x * ((1.8 + variable.particle_random_1 * 2.2) * variable.spd) + variable.vel.x * 20.0) * (variable.dir.x * ((1.8 + variable.particle_random_1 * 2.2) * variable.spd) + variable.vel.x * 20.0) + (variable.dir.y * ((1.8 + variable.particle_random_1 * 2.2) * variable.spd) + variable.vel.y * 20.0) * (variable.dir.y * ((1.8 + variable.particle_random_1 * 2.2) * variable.spd) + variable.vel.y * 20.0) + (variable.dir.z * ((1.8 + variable.particle_random_1 * 2.2) * variable.spd) + variable.vel.z * 20.0) * (variable.dir.z * ((1.8 + variable.particle_random_1 * 2.2) * variable.spd) + variable.vel.z * 20.0)) + 0.01

color: math.lerp(0.97 - 0.12 * variable.lt - 0.25 * variable.lt * variable.lt, 0.55 - 0.15 * variable.lt, variable.om)
math.lerp((1.0 - variable.lt * variable.lt) * (0.5 + 0.2 * variable.pw), 0.35 * (1.0 - variable.lt), variable.om)
